replay_contract.mutation_materialization: Each survivor record names the exact pytest node that materializes its prohibited live-shaped input using tmp_path, monkeypatch, an isolated repository fixture, or an explicit API argument. The record's command executes those source bytes at execution_head.
replay_contract.intended_red_observation: Each selected node asserts that its prohibited input reaches and is rejected by the named retained oracle. A passing aggregate is therefore the green harness result around an asserted in-process red witness, not a claim that an unasserted mutation stayed green.
replay_contract.restore: All materialized inputs are pytest-owned temporary files, monkeypatch state, isolated repositories, or value arguments. Pytest teardown restored them; the subsequent full 42-path cohort returned 535 passed, 2 xfailed.
